verdict.rationale: Ultrametric ships an official npm CLI (`npm install -g ultrametric`) built for agents. It offers a `--json` mode with a stable `schemaVersion`/`data` envelope, `init --dry-run` skill setup, `doctor` diagnostics, and an agent-drivable device-code login. Recorded hands-on sweeps confirm the commands run, return structured errors, and serve real offline guides. missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration (all hands-on runs are the vendor's own self-eval recordings), and evidence of authenticated hosted process commands working end to end (keyless runs only reached the AUTH_REQUIRED wall).
